tree_identity: Git tree of the code used locally to re-read archived 90-minute proofs and produce the ten early forecasts; commit identities may be rewritten during publication.
evidence_type: native public HTTP receipts, actual local receipt/admission times and individually reconstructed regulation proofs
scope: Newly rebuilt local store with the pinned 2010-11 through 2026-27 OpenFootball input. Local player-event and market receipt collections were empty. No prior live seals or fabricated pregame knowledge.

openligadb.attribution: Data from OpenLigaDB (www.openligadb.de), licensed under ODbL 1.0

wikipedia.attribution: English Wikipedia contributors; EPL club season articles identified by the linked revision and authorship history. Match reports extracted and normalized by polymarket861.
wikipedia.independence: Two club articles remain one community provider. Their link to a Premier League match identifies the event, it does not count as a third native score receipt.

access_limit: Locally retained original bytes are required to recreate their exact receipt digests. An upstream revision can be inspected using its permanent URL. These late receipts do not establish information available before kickoff.

manual_review_evidence.source: English Wikipedia club-season revisions, CC BY-SA 4.0; match 2645225

matches.locator: MediaWiki query.pages entries titled 2026–27 AFC Bournemouth season (revision 1387421265), 2026–27 Brentford F.C. season (revision 1387568640); Premier League / football box / round 4 / official match 2645225.
matches.decision_reason: Codex research review of EPL 2645225: both English Wikipedia club-season revisions report the 90-minute score of 2–2, consistent with the pinned OpenFootball file and the official match report. The archived OpenLigaDB final reports 2–1. Review scope: training only.
